note: VH5 helicopter flight feel (src/heli.cpp, docs/vehicles.md#helicopter). Angles in degrees, speeds m/s, times s. Positive pitch = nose up, positive bank = right side down. Every rate is applied frame-rate independently (exponential approach with a time constant, or a per-second limit).

attitude.note: W / S pitch the nose down / up, A / D bank; the airframe eases to the target attitude (tau) no faster than maxRate

thrust.note: horizontal acceleration = g x tan(tilt) x tiltAccel along the tilt: forward pitch drives forward speed, bank drives sideways speed; S while moving forward pitches up and brakes before it reverses

drag.note: a = -v x linear - v |v| x quadratic: full forward tilt (30 deg) settles near 83 m/s (300 km/h), ~200 km/h after 5-6 s; backward and sideways speeds are capped softly

assist.note: with no directional input the airframe tilts against its own drift (gain deg per m/s, up to maxTilt) and a light extra damping (driftDamp /s) bleeds speed, so it levels and slows but keeps momentum; below hoverSpeed hoverDamp holds it near still

yaw.note: the nose follows the mouse yaw at up to rateHover (still) .. rateFast (fast); the flight path swings toward the nose at velocityAlign /s, so turns at speed are wide arcs unless the pilot banks and brakes

lift.note: Space / Ctrl set a climb / sink target reached at up to accel m/s2 (tau); on release the vertical speed eases to a hold over releaseTau

hover.note: a slow, gentle attitude drift in the hover (no constant correcting needed)

landing.note: touchdown compresses the gear (spring-damper, at most suspensionMax m); above softImpact m/s a thud, above hardImpact a camera jolt and a heavy sound scaled with the excess

camera.note: chase camera: follows with a short lag (s) and trails a little against acceleration (accelLag s, at most accelLagMax m); banks rollFactor of the airframe's bank; rotor vibration amplitude (m) at full rotor speed; Settings > Gameplay > Helicopter camera motion scales roll, vibration and shake (0..3, default 1), Reduced motion multiplies it by 0.3
